Name: NMDPABORhTypeVS
Title: ABO/Rh Blood Type Value Set
Description: LOINC Answer List LL2972-9 codes for ABO and Rh blood group types.

Name: NMDPCenterTypeVS
Title: NMDP Center Type ValueSet
Description: All center types in the NMDP network.

Name: NMDPCMVStatusVS
Title: NMDP CMV Status Value Set
Description: Allowable text-based values for CMV IgG antibody presence status used in NMDP donor and CBU payloads.

Name: NMDPDonorStatusVS
Title: NMDP Donor Status ValueSet
Description: All registry status codes for NMDP registered donors. Maps to ODS enterprise donor status values (AV, TU, AC, DE).

Name: NMDPGLStringVS
Title: GL String Code Value Set
Description: Genotype List String Codes from glstring.org. Codes represent HLA genotypes in GL String format (e.g., hla#3.25.0#HLA-A*01:01:01:01+HLA-A*01:02).

Name: NMDPHLAGeneNameVS
Title: NMDP HLA Gene Name Value Set
Description: HLA gene names (HGNC IDs) for loci typed in NMDP donor operations.

Name: NMDPHLALocusLOINCVS
Title: NMDP HLA Locus LOINC Value Set
Description: LOINC codes for HLA locus-specific high resolution typing observations used in NMDP donor and CBU payloads.

Name: NMDPOrderTypeVS
Title: NMDP Order Type Value Set
Description: All codes from the NMDP Order Type code system.

Name: NMDPSpecimenTypeVS
Title: NMDP Specimen Type Value Set
Description: All specimen type codes for donor testing samples in the NMDP system.
